title: Final Energy Levels
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and express the three distinct energy levels after perturbation in terms of A and B.

title: Wave Function Forms
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide the correct forms of the wave functions associated with each energy level.

title: Expectation Value Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the expectation value of L_z for each of the three levels and state it correctly.

title: Energy Shift Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the energy shifts using perturbation theory and show the steps clearly.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect signs or factors in the energy level expressions.
